models.model_label: Table 5, Model 4, Panels A–C: monthly stock returns on NOA, Accruals, and asset-pricing controls
models.sample_description: NYSE, AMEX, and Nasdaq firms from the 2002 Compustat/CRSP intersection with data to compute Accruals, NOA, size, and book-to-market; sample period July 1964–December 2002. Table 5 estimates monthly cross-sectional regressions from July 1966 through December 2002, excludes negative book-value firms, and requires at least four months between fiscal year-end and return month t. The source reports 438 monthly cross-sectional coefficient estimates but no exact observation count for any month.
models.method_details: The paper identifies the Fama–MacBeth procedure and monthly cross-sectional regressions, but does not state the estimator used for each monthly cross-section.

dependent_variable.name: Monthly stock return
dependent_variable.definition: Individual-stock return in month t, used as the dependent variable in each monthly cross-sectional regression. Table 5 calls it a stock return but does not specify whether it is raw or adjusted.

review_notes: Source-first selection: the abstract and introduction present scaled NOA as a strong negative predictor of subsequent stock returns. Table 5 Model 4 is the final full-control Fama–MacBeth specification, including both Accruals and NOA with standard asset-pricing controls; Panels A–C repeat it at 1-, 2-, and 3-fiscal-year accounting-predictor lags. Table 7 Panel A repeats Table 5 Panel A Model 4 and is retained only as a duplicate location. Portfolio sorts, alternate NOA definitions, components, and Mishkin forecasts are follow-up analyses.

The source reports Fama–MacBeth monthly cross-sectional regressions but does not identify the estimator used in each monthly cross-section, the return convention for the dependent variable, or exact monthly fit N. The Table 5-specific Ret(-36:-13) window ends at t−13; Section 3.2 on physical page 13 describes the same variable label through t−12, so the timing discrepancy remains flagged.
results_review_notes: Only the frozen Table 5 Model 4 baseline across Panels A–C is extracted. Table 7 Panel A duplicates Table 5 Panel A Model 4 and is not added as another result set; robustness and additional tests are outside scope.
The 438 count refers to monthly coefficient estimates in the Fama–MacBeth time-series averages, not firm-month observations.

Table 1 Panel A/B means and medians are reported for NOA-sorted annual portfolios; decile-specific Ns are not reported, and contemporaneous NOA/Accruals summaries are not treated as exact summaries of lagged predictors.

Table 1 has no distributional summary rows for monthly stock returns or the past-return controls. Table 2 reports correlations, not variable descriptives; those values are not treated as descriptive statistics.

The Table 5 note defines Ret(−36:−13) through t−13, while Section 3.2 on physical page 13 says the same labeled window runs through t−12. Preserve the Table 5 label and note for the selected coefficient rows and flag the source conflict.

Table 1 NOA and Accruals summaries are contemporaneous NOA-ranking-year portfolio values, not exact summaries of the lagged 1–3-year regressors. Their uncertain local links and the different sample relation are retained with the timing limitation explicit.
